body: Operational note (observed by the planner on 2026-09-12 in this deployment, not part of the plan): a bash tool call sometimes arrives with 2-3 stacked 'export LEGION_GRANT=...' blocks. Only the FIRST one redeems (200 from /legion/v1/gh-token); the later ones 403 ('Unable to redeem LEGION_GRANT (403)'), and since the last export wins, 'legion gh' and 'jj git push' fail on those calls. Workaround that worked: in one bash call install a recorder in the persistent shell -- GRANTS_SEEN=(); export() { local a; for a in "$@"; do case "$a" in LEGION_GRANT=*) GRANTS_SEEN+=("${a#LEGION_GRANT=}");; esac; done; builtin export "$@"; } -- then in the NEXT call run: unset -f export; pick the grant in GRANTS_SEEN whose POST to http://127.0.0.1:13370/legion/v1/gh-token returns 200, and run LEGION_GRANT=<that> jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git push --bookmark legion/LEGION-30 (or legion gh -- ...). Also: the working copy carries .omp/config.yml (empty, written by provisionIssueWorkspace, not on main) -- carve commits with explicit paths and set the bookmark on the last real commit (see plan.json constraints).
